column1: # browsers.tsv -- declarative browser configuration.
# Policies and preferences only. Profiles -- cookies, saved logins, history --
# are never touched: see browsers/README.md.
# Format: kind <TAB> source <TAB> ...
#   policy  source <TAB> destination
#           Written with `install -Dm644` as root. Chromium-family browsers
#           and Firefox both read a managed-policy JSON from /etc, which is
#           the one place a setting cannot be un-set from inside the browser.
#   userjs  source <TAB> label <TAB> profile root [<TAB> profile root ...]
#           Linked into every profile directory found under those roots.
#           Firefox-family profiles have generated directory names, so they are
#           discovered rather than assumed, and they do not exist until the
#           browser has been launched once.
#           More than one root is allowed because a browser's profile directory
#           is not a stable thing: Zen moved from ~/.zen to ~/.config/zen, and a
#           file written to the root the browser is not using is invisible
#           rather than an error. ~/.config/zen is where zen-browser-bin 1.21
#           keeps profiles; ~/.zen is kept for older builds and the flatpak.
# Paths starting with ~ are relative to HOME; everything else is absolute, and
# both are prefixed by --root when one is given.
